items.hak: 這兩隻係吾㜆吾爸，其兜係在英國開餐館嘅。
items.rom: ngia3 | liong3 | zak5 | he4 | nga1 mi1 | nga1 ba1, gia1 deu1 | he4 | coi1 | yin1 get5 | hoi1 | con1 gon3 | e4.
items.zh: 這兩個是我父母，他們是在英國開餐館的。
items.en: These two are my parents, they run a restaurant in the UK.

items.rom: ngia1 deu1 | coi1 | yin1 get5 | lai4 li1 | e4 | le1?
items.en: Where in the UK are you?

items.hak: 吾兜住在倫敦外面。但吾兜嘅餐館在倫敦。
items.rom: nga1 deu1 | cu4 | coi1 | lun2 dun1 | ngoi4 mien4. tan4 | nga1 deu1 e4 | con1 gon3 | coi1 | lun2 dun1.
items.zh: 我們住在倫敦外面。但我們的餐館在倫敦。
items.en: We live outside London. But our restaurant is in London.

items.hak: 其兜兩公婆嘅兄弟姊妹也係在英國嘅麼？
items.rom: gia1 deu1 | liong3 gung1 po2 | e4 | hiung1 ti4 | zi3 moi4 | ya1 | he4 | coi1 | yin1 get5 | e4 mo1?
items.zh: 他們兩夫妻的兄弟姊妹也是在英國的嗎？
items.en: Are both their siblings also in the UK?

items.hak: 係呀，吾兜嘅親戚全部都在倫敦附近。
items.rom: he4 | a1, nga1 deu1 e4 | cin1 cit5 | cien2 pu4 | du1 | coi1 | lun2 dun1 | fu4 kiun4.
items.zh: 是呀，我們的親戚全部都在倫敦附近。
items.en: Yes, all our relatives are near London.

items.hak: 惹兜嘅家庭聚會咩好多人咯？
items.rom: ngia1 deu1 e4 | ga1 tin2 | ci4 fui4 | me4 | hau3 | do1 | ngin2 | lo1?
items.zh: 你們的家庭聚會不就很多人嗎？
items.en: Isn't your family gathering very large then?

items.hak: 係呀，擺擺都有兩十幾人嘅呀。
items.rom: he4 | a1, bai3 bai3 | du1 | yiu1 | liong3 sip6 gi3 | ngin2 | e4 | a1.
items.zh: 是呀，每次都有二十幾人的。
items.en: Yes, every time there are twenty-something people.

items.hak: 哇，好鬧熱噢。惹兜好開心喔。
items.rom: va1, hau3 | lau4 ngiet6 | o1. ngia1 deu1 | hau3 | hoi1 sim1 | o1.
items.zh: 哇，好熱鬧耶。你們好開心啊。
items.en: Wow, so lively. You must be very happy.

items.hak: 係呀，吾㜆曉煮好多客家菜，好好食嘅呀。
items.rom: he4 | a1, nga1 mi1 | hiau3 | zu3 | hau3 | do1 | hak5 ga1 | coi4, hau3 | hau3 sit6 | e4 | a1.
items.zh: 是呀，我媽媽會做很多客家菜，很好吃的呀。
items.en: Yes, my mom cooks a lot of Hakka dishes, they are delicious.

items.rom: ngia1 deu1 | zin1 he4 | hau3 sit6 luk5 | lo1.
items.en: You really have good luck with food.

items: 其兜有冇兄弟姊妹？有幾多隻？
吾㜆 + 有/冇 + ...姊妹。吾爸 + 有/冇 ... 姊妹。
惹兜嘅親戚多唔多家庭聚會？
吾㜆煮菜好好食。吾兜擺擺都好開心。

items.zh: 香港客家話屬於**惠陽腔**，沒有介音 `u`，所以 {{廣}}/{{港}} `gŏng`、{{關}}/{{間}} `gán`、{{過}}/{{個}} `gò`、{{郭}}/{{角}} `gŏk` 同音。
items.en: Hong Kong Hakka belongs to the **Fuiyong accent** and lacks the `u`-medial. Therefore, {{廣}}/{{港}} `gŏng`, {{關}}/{{間}} `gán`, {{過}}/{{個}} `gò`, {{郭}}/{{角}} `gŏk` are homophones.

items.zh: {{國}}傳統發音是 `gĕt`，近似英語的「get」，不唸 `gŏk`。
items.en: The traditional pronunciation of {{國}} is `gĕt`, similar to the English 'get', not `gŏk`.

items.zh: 客家話有 `m` **收音**，除了幾個字以外，絕大部分和廣州話相同。
items.en: Hakka has the **m-ending**. Except for a few characters, it is largely the same as in Cantonese.

items.zh: **人稱代名詞複數**是**屬格**加詞綴{兜: deu1} ({吾兜: nga1 deu1} = 'we')。複數的**屬格**只需要加{嘅: e4} ({吾兜嘅: nga1 deu1 e4} = 'our')。
items.en: **Plural personal pronouns** are formed by adding the suffix {兜: deu1} to the **genitive** form ({吾兜: nga1 deu1} = 'we'). The **plural genitive** only requires adding {嘅: e4} ({吾兜嘅: nga1 deu1 e4} = 'our').

items.zh: 客家話的**量詞**：一般用{隻: zak5}代替廣州話的「個」（{一隻人: yit5 | zak5 | ngin2}），而四條腿的動物是{條: tiau2}（{一條貓公: yit5 | tiau2 | miau4 gung1}）。
items.en: Hakka **classifiers**: {隻: zak5} is generally used instead of Cantonese's 「個」 (e.g., 'one person' - {一隻人: yit5 | zak5 | ngin2}). For four-legged animals, {條: tiau2} is used (e.g., 'one male cat' - {一條貓公: yit5 | tiau2 | miau4 gung1}).

items.zh: {{幾}}在發問，或者意思為「甚為」的時候，發音是 `gĭt`。另外也有 `gĭ` 的發音，例如{幾十歲: gi3 sip6 soi4}、{幾百年: gi3 bat5 ngien2}、{第幾: ti4 gi3}。
items.en: When {{幾}} is used in questions or means 'what/why', it is pronounced `gĭt`. There is also the pronunciation `gĭ`, used in e.g., 'tens of years old' ({幾十歲: gi3 sip6 soi4}), 'hundreds of years' ({幾百年: gi3 bat5 ngien2}), 'which one (ordinal)' ({第幾: ti4 gi3}).
